description:
"From the day he witnessed his father's death, high school student Yoo Hyeon-jae gains the ability to see ghosts and the power to exorcise them. Then a mysterious presence appears. A ghost with red eyes who was the top student in school during his lifetime crosses paths with Hyeon-jae. 

"I want to become a lawyer. Help me." 

"Law school? I'll personally make sure you get there."

 Coexisting with the ghost "Red Eyes," Hyeon-jae becomes a lawyer. He chooses the path of a good attorney to help those who, like his father, have been unjustly wronged. To prove the innocence of the living and deliver the truth of the dead, "The Lawyer Who Sees Souls" is on his way.

[Original Novel](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=8291401)
